notes: I changed the rule: only the **first character** of each string is shifted +1 and then uppercased if it lands on a lowercase letter; all other characters shift +1 normally. This explains "abc123"→"Bcd234", "level"→"Mfwfm", "banana"→"Cbobob", "test case"→"Uftu!dbtf" (t→U, but c in "case"→d stays lower). The odd "Z"→"{" in " Zebralower" is marked uncertain.
